items.title: Document the Lattice Parallel Wave execution contract
items.context: Write the detailed execution document before implementation. It must map Parallel Wave to Lattice concepts, define wave JSON, authority boundaries, and the six implementation milestones without conflicting with Canonical Story v0.
items.userSees: User can read docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-parallel-wave.md and see the six-step Parallel Wave flow, schema shape, authority boundary, and no-productionDone rule.

happy.desc: Document defines Parallel Wave as collection-level scheduling over Canonical Stories with six execution milestones.

edge.desc: Document explains why Canonical Story v0 is not modified and how wave metadata references stories instead.

adversarial.desc: Document explicitly says wave artifacts, handoff packs, local JSON, and capability probes cannot satisfy DONE or production authority.

verificationEvidence.note: Decision doc defines Parallel Wave as collection-level scheduling over Canonical Stories with the six implementation milestones.
Decision doc states Canonical Story v0 remains unchanged and wave metadata references stories instead.
Decision doc states wave artifacts and local JSON cannot satisfy DONE or production authority.

items.title: Implement the Parallel Wave core model
items.context: Add a collection-level model that references stories, evaluates dependencies/hotspots/lanes, emits visible degradations, and preserves local-vs-production authority semantics.
items.userSees: Core wave model returns story lanes, readiness, visible degradations, authorityChanged=false, productionDone=false, and merge order in JSON.

happy.desc: Independent supporting story with available host capability becomes a parallel DEV candidate.

edge.desc: A story depending on an active story is blocked or plan_only even if metadata says parallelSafe=yes.

adversarial.desc: Shared hotspot overlap produces visible degradation and removes the story from parallel DEV candidates.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke test asserts the independent supporting story becomes a parallel DEV candidate on a capable host.
Smoke test asserts an active dependency blocks a story even with explicit parallelSafe=yes.
Smoke test asserts shared hotspot overlap degrades explicit parallelSafe=yes to plan_only.

items.title: Add CLI surfaces for wave creation, inspection, and planning
items.context: Expose stable CLI/JSON commands for creating a wave plan from story refs, inspecting it, and producing a parallel execution plan for multi-worktree delivery.
items.userSees: koala help lists parallel_wave_create, parallel_wave_inspect, and parallel_plan; each command supports JSON output and text output.

happy.desc: CLI can create and inspect a wave from seeded stories and emits parseable JSON.

edge.desc: parallel_plan can run without a wave file by analyzing active stories, and with a wave file by reading the no-overwrite artifact.

adversarial.desc: parallel_wave_create refuses to overwrite an existing output file.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke test exercises create and inspect through registry and real CLI JSON output.
Smoke test exercises parallel_plan without a wave file and with a wave file path.
Smoke test asserts output writes refuse to overwrite existing wave, inspect, and plan artifacts.

items.title: Integrate capability, degradation, evidence, and merge-order guidance
items.context: Use existing capability probes and Lattice evidence semantics so dispatch readiness, missing capabilities, stale evidence, and ordered merge guidance are explicit and non-authoritative unless receipts exist.
items.userSees: Wave output names host capability degradation, evidence refs, refresh guidance, merge blockers, and production authority boundary.

happy.desc: Host candidate summaries include capability status and degradation counts from capability probes.

edge.desc: Evidence refs are preserved as references only and do not refresh stale evidence or change authority.

adversarial.desc: Missing or conditional receipt-verify capability blocks productionDone and keeps top-level receiptRefs empty.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke test asserts host candidates include capability status and degradation summaries.
Smoke test asserts evidence refs are preserved as references while authority remains unchanged.
Smoke test asserts conditional receipt capability blocks productionDone and top-level receiptRefs stay empty.

items.title: Add focused smoke tests and command policy coverage
items.context: Cover happy, edge, and adversarial behavior: independent stories parallelize, dependencies block DEV, shared hotspots degrade to plan_only, missing receipt capability blocks productionDone, and wave artifacts cannot satisfy gates by themselves.
items.userSees: npm run test:lattice-parallel-wave-smoke passes and proves command registration, policy/fact-level coverage, and wave behavior.

happy.desc: Smoke test asserts MAIN_TOOLS and registry expose all three wave commands.

edge.desc: Smoke test asserts command-policy classifies all wave commands as readOnly/non-authority.

adversarial.desc: Smoke test asserts process-fact levels classify all wave commands as L0 and not gate evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke test asserts MAIN_TOOLS and registry expose all three Parallel Wave commands.
Smoke test asserts command-policy classifies all wave commands as readOnly and non-authority.
Smoke test asserts process-fact levels classify all wave commands as L0 and not gate evidence.

items.title: Record validation evidence and product-facing usage
items.context: Run build/smoke/validate commands, record verification evidence per checklist item, and summarize the final user-visible workflow for future agents.
items.userSees: Final validation transcript shows build pass, lattice parallel wave smoke pass, scope check pass, and koala validate pass.

happy.desc: Build and focused lattice parallel wave smoke test pass.

edge.desc: Scope contract check passes without forbidden writes.

adversarial.desc: koala validate confirms all checklist verification intents are covered before DONE.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-parallel-wave-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Build and focused Lattice Parallel Wave smoke test passed in this DEV session.
Scope contract check passed with zero unacknowledged violations for the declared write set.
Final Koala validate command is run after recording evidence to confirm checklist coverage and gate state.
